_hints._usage: Copy this file, fill every null/empty field from AUTHORIZED SMIC40 platform material, then run scripts/check_technology.py --config <this file>. This file itself is a template: check_technology.py must still report missing items until all fields are populated. Never edit smic40.binding.pending.json.
_hints._path_rule: Relative paths are resolved against the directory containing the config file (check_technology.py:26). Absolute paths are accepted but reduce portability.
_hints._frozen_contract: check_technology.py:29-32 hard-codes top=kwt1_mmio, clock=clk@6.666667ns, sram instances=20, depth=4096, width=16, boundary_module=kwt_tech_sram_4096x16, read_latency_cycles=1, read_output_holds=true, write_preserves_read_output=true. A real macro that violates any of these produces errors (not missing) and can never pass. Reopen scheduling/latency and equivalence review explicitly before changing anything (flow/README.md:64-68).
_hints.clock.uncertainty_ns: Positive number from the designated platform/library timing document or PLL/jitter spec. Record the document in clock.source.
_hints.clock.source: Path or identifier of the authorized document that defines jitter/uncertainty.
_hints.sram.wrapper_rtl: Path to the real macro wrapper RTL. It MUST declare: module kwt_tech_sram_4096x16 (check_technology.py:34). Do not point at rtl/integration/tech_sram_model.sv (behavioral array model).
_hints.sram.physical_cell: Exact physical macro cell name from the foundry/macro datasheet.
_hints.sram.source: Authorized macro datasheet / Liberty / LEF identifier covering pin polarity and timing.
_hints.sram.area_per_instance_um2: Positive number, actual macro area in um^2 per instance from the authorized macro data. Used 20x in the complete counted area. CACTI/BSG analytical values are NOT acceptable.
_hints.sram.pin_map: Dictionary keyed by clk, en, we, addr, wdata, rdata. Each entry needs physical_pin (string) and polarity (documented active-high/active-low or bus semantics). Example: {"en": {"physical_pin": "CEN", "polarity": "active_high"}}.
_hints.sram.behavior_models: List of paths to the authorized macro simulation/Verilog models (one or more). Files must exist.
_hints.corners: Non-empty list. Each corner needs: name, process, voltage_v, temperature_c, time_unit, capacitance_unit, source, standard_cell_liberty (list of existing .lib paths), sram_liberty (list of existing .lib paths). Cover setup and hold corners required by the platform. Do not invent PVT from the 40nm label.
_hints.io.source: Authorized document defining I/O drive/load and delay values.
_hints.io.reset_constraints: Reset removal/recovery and reset-domain constraints from the designated platform.
_hints.io.input_delay_ns: One positive delay for EACH non-clk/rst_n input port of rtl/v2/kwt1_mmio.sv. Print the exact 14 names with: python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'scripts');import check_technology as t;print(sorted(k for k in t.ports() if k not in ('clk','rst_n')))"
_hints.io.output_delay_ns: One positive delay for EACH non-clk/rst_n output port, same method as input_delay_ns.
_hints.exceptions: Optional. Every entry needs source and reason. Whole-domain scopes all / clock_domain and SDC set_false_path on all_inputs/all_outputs/all_clocks are rejected.
_hints.constraints_sdc: Path to a reviewed SDC file generated on the server. MUST contain: create_clock with 6.66666, set_input_delay, set_output_delay, set_clock_uncertainty. Must NOT contain a broad false path. Include macro coQ/setup/hold/load, I/O drive/load, reset conversion, clock tree and uncertainty.
_hints._post_check: A passing preflight yields physical_signoff=false by design. It only proves configuration/source/constraint screening is complete; STA, area and power signoff are separate later stages.

note: Server-side fill-in template derived from smic40.binding.pending.json. No library, PVT, macro area, pin polarity or timing value is inferred from the process node. Do not commit filled paths/values as if they were reviewed constraints.
